rows.en: Last Christmas, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, decided to take some presents to a children’s hospital.
rows.zh: 去年圣诞节，马戏团老板吉米·盖茨决定给一家儿童医院送些礼物。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Dressed up as Father Christmas and accompanied by a ‘guard of honour’ of six pretty girls, he set off down the main street of the city riding a baby elephant called Jumbo.
rows.zh: 他装扮成圣诞老人，在由六位漂亮姑娘组成的“仪仗队”陪同下，骑着一头名叫江伯的小象，沿着城里的主要街道出发了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He should have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing.
rows.zh: 他本该知道，警察绝不会允许这种事情发生。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A policeman approached Jimmy and told him he ought to have gone along a side street as Jumbo was holding up the traffic.
rows.zh: 一名警察走到吉米面前，告诉他本来应该走一条小街，因为江伯堵塞了交通。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Though Jimmy agreed to go at once, Jumbo refused to move.
rows.zh: 虽然吉米同意马上离开，江伯却不肯挪动。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Fifteen policemen had to push very hard to get him off the main street.
rows.zh: 十五名警察不得不用力推，才把它推出主要街道。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The police had a difficult time, but they were most amused.
rows.zh: 警察们忙得够呛，却觉得十分有趣。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘Jumbo must weigh a few tons,’ said a policeman afterwards, ‘so it was fortunate that we didn’t have to carry him.
rows.zh: “江伯肯定有好几吨重，”一名警察事后说，“所以幸好我们不用抬着它走。
rows.speaker: 警察

rows.en: Of course, we should arrest him, but as he has a good record, we shall let him off this time.’
rows.zh: 当然，我们应该逮捕它，不过既然它一贯表现良好，这回我们就饶了它吧。”
rows.speaker: 警察

rows.en: In 1963 a Lancaster bomber crashed on Wallis Island, a remote place in the South Pacific, a long way west of Samoa.
rows.zh: 1963年，一架兰开斯特轰炸机坠毁在瓦利斯岛上；那是南太平洋中一处偏僻的地方，位于萨摩亚以西很远的海域。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The plane wasn’t too badly damaged, but over the years, the crash was forgotten and the wreck remained undisturbed.
rows.zh: 飞机损坏得并不太严重，但多年过去，坠机事件被人遗忘了，飞机残骸也一直无人碰过。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Then in 1989, twenty-six years after the crash, the plane was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey of the island.
rows.zh: 后来到了1989年，也就是坠机二十六年后，人们在对该岛进行一次航空勘测时，意外地重新发现了这架飞机。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: By this time, a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare and worth rescuing.
rows.zh: 到这时，保存状况还算良好的兰开斯特轰炸机已经十分罕见，值得抢救。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France.
rows.zh: 法国有关部门让人把飞机分拆包装，运回法国。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Now a group of enthusiasts are going to have the plane restored.
rows.zh: 现在，一群爱好者准备请人修复这架飞机。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It has four Rolls-Royce Merlin engines, but the group will need to have only three of them rebuilt.
rows.zh: 它有四台劳斯莱斯“梅林”发动机，但这群人只需要请人翻修其中三台。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Imagine their surprise and delight when they broke open the packing cases and found that the fourth engine was sweet as honey — still in perfect condition.
rows.zh: 想象一下，当他们撬开包装箱，发现第四台发动机甜如蜂蜜，而且仍然完好无损时，是多么惊喜！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive and it was totally preserved in beeswax!
rows.zh: 一群蜜蜂把发动机变成了蜂巢，发动机被蜂蜡完整地保存了下来！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Haroun Tazieff, the Polish scientist, has spent his lifetime studying active volcanoes and deep caves in all parts of the world.
rows.zh: 波兰科学家哈鲁恩·塔齐耶夫把一生都用来研究世界各地的活火山和深洞。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In 1948, he went to Lake Kivu in the Congo to observe a new volcano which he later named Kituro.
rows.zh: 1948年，他前往刚果的基伍湖，观察一座新出现的火山，后来他把这座火山命名为基图罗。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano while it was erupting violently.
rows.zh: 塔齐耶夫在火山猛烈喷发时，竟能把营地扎在离火山很近的地方。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs, he could not stay near the volcano for very long.
rows.zh: 虽然他设法拍到了许多精彩的照片，却无法在火山附近久留。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He noticed that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him.
rows.zh: 他注意到，一股熔岩正像河流一样向他涌来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It threatened to surround him completely, but Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
rows.zh: 熔岩眼看就要把他完全包围，但塔齐耶夫设法及时逃了出去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He waited until the volcano became quiet and he was able to return two days later.
rows.zh: 他一直等到火山平静下来，两天后才得以返回。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This time, he managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro so that he could take photographs and measure temperatures.
rows.zh: 这一次，他设法爬进了基图罗的火山口，以便拍照和测量温度。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.
rows.zh: 塔齐耶夫经常这样冒着生命危险。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.
rows.zh: 关于活火山，他向我们提供的知识比任何在世的人都多。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I crossed the street to avoid meeting him, but he saw me and came running towards me.
rows.zh: 我穿过马路，想避开他，可他看见了我，朝我跑了过来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was no use pretending that I had not seen him, so I waved to him.
rows.zh: 假装没看见他已经没有用了，于是我向他挥了挥手。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I never enjoy meeting Nigel Dykes.
rows.zh: 我从来都不喜欢遇到奈杰尔·戴克斯。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He never has anything to do.
rows.zh: 他总是无事可做。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: No matter how busy you are, he always insists on coming with you.
rows.zh: 不管你有多忙，他总是坚持要跟着你。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I had to think of a way of preventing him from following me around all morning.
rows.zh: 我得想个办法，免得他整个上午都跟在我身边。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘Hello, Nigel,’ I said.
rows.zh: “你好，奈杰尔，”我说。
rows.speaker: 伊丽莎白（我）

rows.en: ‘Fancy meeting you here!’
rows.zh: “真没想到在这里碰见你！”
rows.speaker: 伊丽莎白（我）

rows.en: ‘Hi, Elizabeth,’ Nigel answered.
rows.zh: “嗨，伊丽莎白，”奈杰尔回答。
rows.speaker: 奈杰尔

rows.en: ‘I was just wondering how to spend the morning — until I saw you.
rows.zh: “刚才我还在琢磨这个上午该怎么过，直到我看见了你。
rows.speaker: 奈杰尔

rows.en: You're not busy doing anything, are you?’
rows.zh: 你没忙什么事吧？”
rows.speaker: 奈杰尔

rows.en: ‘No, not at all,’ I answered.
rows.zh: “没有，一点也不忙，”我回答。
rows.speaker: 伊丽莎白（我）

rows.en: ‘I'm going to ...’
rows.zh: “我正要去……”
rows.speaker: 伊丽莎白（我）

rows.en: ‘Would you mind my coming with you?’ he asked, before I had finished speaking.
rows.zh: 我还没说完，他就问：“我跟你一起去，你介意吗？”
rows.speaker: 奈杰尔

rows.en: ‘Not at all,’ I lied, ‘but I'm going to the dentist.’
rows.zh: “一点也不介意，”我撒谎说，“不过，我要去看牙医。”
rows.speaker: 伊丽莎白（我）

rows.en: ‘Then I'll come with you,’ he answered.
rows.zh: “那我就跟你一起去，”他回答。
rows.speaker: 奈杰尔

rows.en: ‘There’s always plenty to read in the waiting room!’
rows.zh: “候诊室里总有很多东西可以看！”
rows.speaker: 奈杰尔

rows.en: I was being tested for a driving licence for the third time.
rows.zh: 我正在第三次参加驾驶执照考试。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I had been asked to drive in heavy traffic and had done so successfully.
rows.zh: 考官让我在车流繁忙的路段开车，我顺利地完成了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
rows.zh: 接着，考官指示我把车开出城，我开始有了信心。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Sure that I had passed, I was almost beginning to enjoy my test.
rows.zh: 我确信自己已经通过了，几乎开始享受这场考试了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance, for he smiled and said, ‘Just one more thing, Mr. Eames.
rows.zh: 考官一定对我的表现很满意，因为他微笑着说：“就剩最后一项了，伊姆斯先生。
rows.speaker: 旁白与考官

rows.en: Let us suppose that a child suddenly crosses the road in front of you.
rows.zh: 假设有个孩子突然从你前面横穿马路。
rows.speaker: 考官

rows.en: As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.’
rows.zh: 我一敲车窗，你就必须在五英尺内把车停住。”
rows.speaker: 考官

rows.en: I continued driving and after some time, the examiner tapped loudly.
rows.zh: 我继续开车，过了一会儿，考官用力敲了敲车窗。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Though the sound could be heard clearly, it took me a long time to react.
rows.zh: 虽然声音听得很清楚，我却过了很久才反应过来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I suddenly pressed the brake pedal hard and we were both thrown forward.
rows.zh: 我突然用力踩下刹车踏板，我们俩都被向前甩了出去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The examiner looked at me sadly.
rows.zh: 考官难过地望着我。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘Mr. Eames,’ he said, in a mournful voice, ‘you have just killed that child!’
rows.zh: “伊姆斯先生，”他用悲伤的语气说，“你刚才已经把那个孩子撞死了！”
rows.speaker: 考官

rows.en: During a bullfight, a drunk suddenly wandered into the middle of the ring.
rows.zh: 一场斗牛正在进行时，一个醉汉突然晃进了斗牛场中央。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The crowd began to shout, but the drunk was unaware of the danger.
rows.zh: 观众开始大声叫喊，醉汉却没有意识到危险。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The bull was busy with the matador at the time, but it suddenly caught sight of the drunk who was shouting rude remarks and waving a red cap.
rows.zh: 当时，公牛正忙着对付斗牛士，却突然看见那个醉汉一边骂骂咧咧，一边挥舞着一顶红帽子。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Apparently sensitive to criticism, the bull forgot all about the matador and charged at the drunk.
rows.zh: 公牛似乎对批评十分敏感，把斗牛士全忘了，径直朝醉汉冲去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The crowd suddenly grew quiet.
rows.zh: 观众突然安静下来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The drunk, however, seemed quite sure of himself.
rows.zh: 然而，醉汉似乎对自己十分有把握。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When the bull got close to him, he clumsily stepped aside to let it pass.
rows.zh: 公牛冲到他跟前时，他笨拙地往旁边一闪，让公牛冲了过去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The crowd broke into cheers and the drunk bowed.
rows.zh: 观众爆发出欢呼，醉汉鞠了一躬。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: By this time, however, three men had come into the ring and they quickly dragged the drunk to safety.
rows.zh: 不过这时，已有三个人进了斗牛场，他们迅速把醉汉拖到了安全的地方。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Even the bull seemed to feel sorry for him, for it looked on sympathetically until the drunk was out of the way before once more turning its attention to the matador.
rows.zh: 连公牛似乎也替他感到遗憾，因为它一直带着同情的神情望着醉汉，等他离开以后，才再次把注意力转回斗牛士。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When you visit London, one of the first things you will see is Big Ben, the famous clock which can be heard all over the world on the B.B.C.
rows.zh: 到伦敦游览时，你最先看到的景物之一就是著名的大本钟，世界各地的人们都能通过英国广播公司听到它的钟声。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If the Houses of Parliament had not been burned down in 1834, the great clock would never have been erected.
rows.zh: 要不是议会大厦在1834年被烧毁，这座大钟本来就不会建造。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall who was responsible for the making of the clock when the new Houses of Parliament were being built.
rows.zh: 大本钟以本杰明·霍尔爵士的名字命名，新议会大厦兴建时，他负责监造这座大钟。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is not only of immense size, but is extremely accurate as well.
rows.zh: 它不仅体积巨大，而且走时极其准确。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Officials from Greenwich Observatory have the clock checked twice a day.
rows.zh: 格林尼治天文台的工作人员每天请人校对这座钟两次。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: On the B.B.C. you can hear the clock when it is actually striking because microphones are connected to the clock tower.
rows.zh: 你可以通过英国广播公司实时听到大钟报时，因为麦克风与钟楼相连。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Big Ben has rarely gone wrong.
rows.zh: 大本钟极少出差错。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Once, however, it failed to give the correct time.
rows.zh: 不过，有一次它没能报出准确的时间。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A painter who had been working on the tower hung a pot of paint on one of the hands and slowed it down!
rows.zh: 一位在钟楼上干活的油漆工把一罐油漆挂在了一根指针上，使钟走慢了！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The great racing driver, Sir Malcolm Campbell, was the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour.
rows.zh: 著名赛车手马尔科姆·坎贝尔爵士，是第一个把车开到时速超过三百英里的人。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.
rows.zh: 1935年9月，他在犹他州的邦纳维尔盐滩创下了新的世界纪录。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built for him.
rows.zh: 他驾驶的那辆名叫“蓝鸟”的汽车，是专门为他制造的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was over 30 feet in length and had a 2,500-horsepower engine.
rows.zh: 它的车长超过三十英尺，装有一台两千五百马力的发动机。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour, he had great difficulty in controlling the car because a tyre burst during the first run.
rows.zh: 虽然坎贝尔达到了每小时三百零四英里以上的速度，但由于第一次试跑时有一只轮胎爆裂，他很难控制住汽车。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After his attempt, Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
rows.zh: 尝试过后，坎贝尔得知自己的平均时速为二百九十九英里，十分失望。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: However, a few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
rows.zh: 然而，几天后，有人告诉他，先前弄错了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: His average speed had been 301 miles per hour.
rows.zh: 他的平均时速其实是三百零一英里。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Since that time, racing drivers have reached speeds over 600 miles an hour.
rows.zh: 从那以后，赛车手们已经达到了每小时六百英里以上的速度。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Following in his father’s footsteps many years later, Sir Malcolm's son, Donald, also set up a world record.
rows.zh: 多年后，马尔科姆爵士的儿子唐纳德追随父亲的脚步，也创下了一项世界纪录。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Like his father, he was driving a car called Bluebird.
rows.zh: 和父亲一样，他驾驶的汽车也叫“蓝鸟”。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
rows.zh: 逃学的孩子缺乏想象力。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A quiet day's fishing, or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get.
rows.zh: 安安静静钓一天鱼，或是在电影院里待八个小时，把同一部电影看上一遍又一遍，通常就是他们所能想到的最大花样了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant, travelled 1,600 miles.
rows.zh: 一个男孩在逃学期间旅行了一千六百英里，让他们全都相形见绌。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He hitchhiked to Dover and, towards evening, went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep.
rows.zh: 他搭便车到了多佛，傍晚时走上一条船，想找个地方睡觉。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais.
rows.zh: 第二天早晨醒来时，他发现船已经在这期间驶到了加来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: No one noticed the boy as he crept off.
rows.zh: 男孩偷偷溜下船时，没有人注意到他。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: From there, he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry.
rows.zh: 从那里，他搭上一辆卡车前往巴黎。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city.
rows.zh: 司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，把他留在巴黎城外不远的地方。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would, but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border.
rows.zh: 男孩接着拦下的那辆车，并没有像他希望的那样把他带进巴黎市中心，而是把他带到了法西边境上的佩皮尼昂。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities.
rows.zh: 在那里，他被一名警察带走，又由当地有关部门送回英国。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He has surely set up a record for the thousands of children who dream of evading school.
rows.zh: 他无疑为成千上万梦想逃学的孩子创下了一项纪录。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: An ancient bus stopped by a dry river bed and a party of famous actors and actresses got off.
rows.zh: 一辆破旧的公共汽车停在一条干涸的河床旁，一群著名的男女演员下了车。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes, they had taken special precautions so that no one should recognize them.
rows.zh: 他们戴着墨镜，穿着旧衣服，特意采取了防范措施，免得有人认出他们。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But as they soon discovered, disguises can sometimes be too perfect.
rows.zh: 不过，他们很快就发现，有时伪装也会太成功。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘This is a wonderful place for a picnic,’ said Gloria Gleam.
rows.zh: “这里真是个野餐的好地方，”格洛丽亚·格利姆说。
rows.speaker: 格洛丽亚·格利姆

rows.en: ‘It couldn’t be better, Gloria,’ Brinksley Meers agreed.
rows.zh: “再好不过了，格洛丽亚，”布林克斯利·米尔斯赞同道。
rows.speaker: 布林克斯利·米尔斯

rows.en: ‘No newspaper men, no film fans!
rows.zh: “没有记者，也没有影迷！
rows.speaker: 布林克斯利·米尔斯

rows.en: Why don’t we come more often?’
rows.zh: 我们为什么不常来呢？”
rows.speaker: 布林克斯利·米尔斯

rows.en: Meanwhile, two other actors, Rockwall Slinger and Merlin Greeves, had carried two large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.
rows.zh: 与此同时，另外两名演员罗克沃尔·斯林格和默林·格里夫斯，已经把两大篮食物搬到了几棵树下的阴凉处。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared.
rows.zh: 大家刚舒舒服服地安顿下来，一个陌生人就出现了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He looked very angry.
rows.zh: 他看起来非常生气。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘Now you get out of here, all of you!’ he shouted.
rows.zh: “现在，你们全都给我离开这里！”他大声喊道。
rows.speaker: 警长

rows.en: ‘I'm sheriff here.
rows.zh: “我是这里的警长。
rows.speaker: 警长

rows.en: Do you see that notice?
rows.zh: 看见那块告示了吗？
rows.speaker: 警长

rows.en: It says “No Camping” — in case you can’t read!’
rows.zh: 上面写着‘禁止露营’——我怕你们不识字，特意告诉你们！”
rows.speaker: 警长

rows.en: ‘Look, sheriff,’ said Rockwall, ‘don’t be too hard on us.
rows.zh: “听我说，警长，”罗克沃尔说，“别对我们这么严厉。
rows.speaker: 罗克沃尔·斯林格

rows.en: I'm Rockwall Slinger and this is Merlin Greeves.’
rows.zh: 我是罗克沃尔·斯林格，这位是默林·格里夫斯。”
rows.speaker: 罗克沃尔·斯林格

rows.en: ‘Oh, is it?’ said the sheriff with a sneer.
rows.zh: “哦，是吗？”警长冷笑着说。
rows.speaker: 警长

rows.en: ‘Well, I'm Brinksley Meers, and my other name is Gloria Gleam.
rows.zh: “那么，我就是布林克斯利·米尔斯，我还有个名字叫格洛丽亚·格利姆。
rows.speaker: 警长

rows.en: Now you get out of here fast!’
rows.zh: 现在，你们赶快给我走！”
rows.speaker: 警长

rows.en: When a light passenger plane flew off course some time ago, it crashed in the mountains and its pilot was killed.
rows.zh: 前些时候，一架轻型客机偏离航线，坠毁在山区，飞行员丧生了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The only passengers, a young woman and her two baby daughters, were unhurt.
rows.zh: 机上仅有的乘客是一名年轻女子和她的两个年幼女儿，她们都没有受伤。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was the middle of winter.
rows.zh: 当时正值隆冬。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Snow lay thick on the ground.
rows.zh: 地上积着厚厚的雪。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The woman knew that the nearest village was miles away.
rows.zh: 那名女子知道，最近的村庄也在数英里以外。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When it grew dark, she turned a suitcase into a bed and put the children inside it, covering them with all the clothes she could find.
rows.zh: 天黑下来时，她把一只手提箱当作床，把孩子们放进里面，再把能找到的所有衣服都盖在她们身上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: During the night, it got terribly cold.
rows.zh: 夜里，天气冷得厉害。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The woman kept as near as she could to the children and even tried to get into the case herself, but it was too small.
rows.zh: 那名女子尽可能地紧挨着孩子们，甚至试图自己也钻进箱子，但箱子太小了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Early next morning, she heard planes passing overhead and wondered how she could send a signal.
rows.zh: 第二天一早，她听到飞机从头顶飞过，琢磨着怎样才能发出信号。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Then she had an idea.
rows.zh: 接着，她有了一个主意。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: She stamped out the letters ‘SOS’ in the snow.
rows.zh: 她在雪地里踩出了“SOS”这几个字母。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Fortunately, a pilot saw the signal and sent a message by radio to the nearest town.
rows.zh: 幸运的是，一名飞行员看见了这个信号，用无线电把消息发给了最近的城镇。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was not long before a helicopter arrived on the scene to rescue the survivors of the plane crash.
rows.zh: 没过多久，一架直升机就赶到现场，营救这次空难的幸存者。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘To end our special news bulletin,’ said the voice of the television announcer, ‘we're going over to the macaroni fields of Calabria.
rows.zh: “在本次特别新闻简报结束之前，”电视播音员的声音说道，“我们把镜头转到卡拉布里亚的通心粉田。
rows.speaker: 电视播音员

rows.en: Macaroni has been grown in this area for over six hundred years.
rows.zh: 这个地区种植通心粉已经有六百多年了。
rows.speaker: 电视播音员

rows.en: Two of the leading growers, Giuseppe Moldova and Riccardo Brabante, tell me that they have been expecting a splendid crop this year and harvesting has begun earlier than usual.
rows.zh: 两位主要种植户朱塞佩·摩尔多瓦和里卡尔多·布拉班特告诉我，他们一直盼望今年获得大丰收，收割也比往年提早开始了。
rows.speaker: 电视播音员

rows.en: Here you can see two workers who, between them, have just finished cutting three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks.
rows.zh: 这里可以看到两位工人，他们俩刚刚合力割下了三车金棕色的通心粉秆。
rows.speaker: 电视播音员

rows.en: The whole village has been working day and night gathering and threshing this year’s crop before the September rains.
rows.zh: 全村的人一直在日夜忙碌，赶在九月的雨季来临之前，收割、脱粒今年的作物。
rows.speaker: 电视播音员

rows.en: On the right, you can see Mrs. Brabante herself.
rows.zh: 右边可以看到布拉班特夫人本人。
rows.speaker: 电视播音员

rows.en: She has been helping her husband for thirty years now.
rows.zh: 到现在，她已经帮丈夫干了三十年了。
rows.speaker: 电视播音员

rows.en: Mrs. Brabante is talking to the manager of the local factory where the crop is processed.
rows.zh: 布拉班特夫人正在同当地一家工厂的经理谈话，收下的作物就在那家工厂加工。
rows.speaker: 电视播音员

rows.en: This last scene shows you what will happen at the end of the harvest: the famous Calabrian macaroni-eating competition!
rows.zh: 最后这个场景向大家展示收获结束时将举行的活动：著名的卡拉布里亚吃通心粉比赛！
rows.speaker: 电视播音员

rows.en: Signor Fratelli, the present champion, has won it every year since 1991.
rows.zh: 现任冠军弗拉特利先生从1991年以来，每年都赢得这项比赛。
rows.speaker: 电视播音员

rows.en: And that ends our special bulletin for today, Thursday, April 1st.
rows.zh: 今天是4月1日，星期四，我们的特别新闻简报到此结束。
rows.speaker: 电视播音员

rows.en: We're now going back to the studio.’
rows.zh: 现在我们把画面交回演播室。”
rows.speaker: 电视播音员

rows.en: The mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. has just had an operation.
rows.zh: 一具属于公元前800年去世的埃及妇女的木乃伊，刚刚接受了一次手术。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The mummy is that of Shepenmut who was once a singer in the Temple of Thebes.
rows.zh: 这具木乃伊属于谢彭穆特，她曾是底比斯神庙的一名歌者。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As there were strange marks on the X-ray plates taken of the mummy, doctors have been trying to find out whether the woman died of a rare disease.
rows.zh: 由于给木乃伊拍摄的X光片上有一些奇怪的斑痕，医生们一直想查明，这名妇女是否死于一种罕见疾病。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The only way to do this was to operate.
rows.zh: 要弄清这一点，唯一的办法就是动手术。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The operation, which lasted for over four hours, proved to be very difficult because of the hard resin which covered the skin.
rows.zh: 手术持续了四个多小时，由于皮肤上覆盖着坚硬的树脂，手术十分困难。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The doctors removed a section of the mummy and sent it to a laboratory.
rows.zh: 医生们从木乃伊上取下一部分，送到了一家实验室。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They also found something which the X-ray plates did not show: a small wax figure of the god Duamutef.
rows.zh: 他们还发现了一件X光片没有显示的东西：一尊小小的杜阿姆特夫神蜡像。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This god which has the head of a cow was normally placed inside a mummy.
rows.zh: 这个长着牛头的神的塑像，通常被放在木乃伊体内。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The doctors have not yet decided how the woman died.
rows.zh: 医生们还没有确定这名妇女的死因。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open, but fortunately this has not happened.
rows.zh: 他们原来担心，剖开木乃伊时，它会碎成片片，不过幸运的是，这种情况并没有发生。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The mummy successfully survived the operation.
rows.zh: 这具木乃伊成功地经受住了手术。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After reading an article entitled ‘Cigarette Smoking and Your Health’ I lit a cigarette to calm my nerves.
rows.zh: 读完一篇题为《吸烟与你的健康》的文章后，我点起一支烟，让自己镇定下来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I smoked with concentration and pleasure as I was sure that this would be my last cigarette.
rows.zh: 我专心而愉快地抽着，因为我确信这将是自己的最后一支烟。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: For a whole week I did not smoke at all and during this time, my wife suffered terribly.
rows.zh: 整整一个星期，我一支烟也没抽，在这期间，我妻子可受了大罪。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I had all the usual symptoms of someone giving up smoking: a bad temper and an enormous appetite.
rows.zh: 我出现了戒烟者常有的各种症状：脾气暴躁，胃口大得惊人。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: My friends kept on offering me cigarettes and cigars.
rows.zh: 朋友们不停地给我递香烟和雪茄。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They made no effort to hide their amusement whenever I produced a packet of sweets from my pocket.
rows.zh: 每当我从口袋里掏出一包糖果时，他们都毫不掩饰自己觉得好笑。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After seven days of this I went to a party.
rows.zh: 这样过了七天后，我去参加了一次聚会。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Everybody around me was smoking and I felt extremely uncomfortable.
rows.zh: 周围人人都在吸烟，我觉得浑身不自在。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When my old friend Brian urged me to accept a cigarette, it was more than I could bear.
rows.zh: 老朋友布赖恩劝我拿一支烟时，我再也抵挡不住了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I took one guiltily, lit it and smoked with satisfaction.
rows.zh: 我心虚地接过一支，点上后心满意足地抽了起来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: My wife was delighted that things had returned to normal once more.
rows.zh: 一切又恢复了正常，妻子十分高兴。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Anyway, as Brian pointed out, it is the easiest thing in the world to give up smoking.
rows.zh: 不管怎么说，正如布赖恩指出的，戒烟是世界上最容易的事。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He himself has done it lots of times!
rows.zh: 他自己就已经戒过很多次了！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.
rows.zh: 小时候，我常常乘飞机旅行。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: My parents used to live in South America and I used to fly there from Europe in the holidays.
rows.zh: 父母那时住在南美洲，放假时，我便从欧洲乘飞机去那里。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A flight attendant would take charge of me and I never had an unpleasant experience.
rows.zh: 总有一名乘务员照看我，我从未有过不愉快的经历。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I am used to travelling by air and only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.
rows.zh: 我已经习惯乘飞机旅行，只有一次感到过害怕。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After taking off, we were flying low over the city and slowly gaining height, when the plane suddenly turned round and flew back to the airport.
rows.zh: 起飞以后，飞机低低地飞过城市，正在慢慢爬升，突然掉头飞回了机场。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: While we were waiting to land, a flight attendant told us to keep calm and to get off the plane quietly as soon as it had touched down.
rows.zh: 等候降落时，一名乘务员让我们保持镇静，飞机一着陆就安静地下机。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Everybody on board was worried and we were curious to find out what had happened.
rows.zh: 机上人人都很担心，我们都急于知道发生了什么事。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Later we learnt that there was a very important person on board.
rows.zh: 后来我们才知道，机上有一位非常重要的人物。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The police had been told that a bomb had been planted on the plane.
rows.zh: 警方接到消息，说有人在飞机上放了炸弹。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After we had landed, the plane was searched thoroughly.
rows.zh: 我们着陆后，飞机接受了彻底搜查。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Fortunately, nothing was found and five hours later we were able to take off again.
rows.zh: 幸运的是，什么也没有发现，五个小时后，我们得以再次起飞。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Perhaps the most extraordinary building of the nineteenth century was the Crystal Palace, which was built in Hyde Park for the Great Exhibition of 1851.
rows.zh: 十九世纪最不同寻常的建筑，也许就是水晶宫；它是为1851年的万国博览会而建在海德公园里的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings in the world, for it was made of iron and glass.
rows.zh: 水晶宫不同于世界上其他所有建筑，因为它是用铁和玻璃建成的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was one of the biggest buildings of all time and a lot of people from many countries came to see it.
rows.zh: 它是有史以来规模最大的建筑之一，许多国家的大批游客都来参观。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition from various parts of the world.
rows.zh: 世界各地的大量商品被运来参展。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
rows.zh: 现场还陈列着大量机器。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The most wonderful piece of machinery on show was Nasmyth’s steam hammer.
rows.zh: 展出的机器中，最令人赞叹的是内史密斯的蒸汽锤。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Though in those days, travelling was not as easy as it is today, steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel from Europe.
rows.zh: 尽管那时旅行不像今天这样方便，汽船仍载着成千上万的游客从欧洲横渡英吉利海峡而来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: On arriving in England, they were taken to the Crystal Palace by train.
rows.zh: 他们一到英国，就被火车送往水晶宫。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: There were six million visitors in all, and the profits from the exhibition were used to build museums and colleges.
rows.zh: 参观者总计有六百万人，博览会的利润被用来建造博物馆和学院。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Later, the Crystal Palace was moved to South London.
rows.zh: 后来，水晶宫被迁到了伦敦南部。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It remained one of the most famous buildings in the world until it was burnt down in 1936.
rows.zh: 在1936年被大火烧毁以前，它一直是世界上最著名的建筑之一。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When he had killed the guard, the prisoner of war quickly dragged him into the bushes.
rows.zh: 那名战俘杀死卫兵后，迅速把他拖进了灌木丛。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Working rapidly in the darkness, he soon changed into the dead man’s clothes.
rows.zh: 他在黑暗中飞快地行动，很快就换上了死者的衣服。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Now, dressed in a blue uniform and with a rifle over his shoulder, the prisoner marched boldly up and down in front of the camp.
rows.zh: 此时，他身穿蓝色制服，肩扛一支步枪，大模大样地在营地前来回走动。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He could hear shouting in the camp itself.
rows.zh: 他能听见营地里面的喊叫声。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Lights were blazing and men were running here and there: they had just discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
rows.zh: 那里灯火通明，人们四处奔跑：他们刚刚发现有一名战俘逃走了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: At that moment, a large black car with four officers inside it, stopped at the camp gates.
rows.zh: 就在这时，一辆黑色大轿车停在营地门口，里面坐着四名军官。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The officers got out and the prisoner stood to attention and saluted as they passed.
rows.zh: 军官们下了车，经过战俘面前时，他立正敬礼。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When they had gone, the driver of the car came towards him.
rows.zh: 等他们走后，汽车司机朝他走了过来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The man obviously wanted to talk.
rows.zh: 这个人显然想聊几句。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He was rather elderly with grey hair and clear blue eyes.
rows.zh: 他年纪已经不小，头发灰白，有一双清澈的蓝眼睛。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The prisoner felt sorry for him, but there was nothing else he could do.
rows.zh: 战俘心里有些同情他，却也别无选择。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As the man came near, the prisoner knocked him to the ground with a sharp blow.
rows.zh: 那个人刚走近，战俘便猛击一下，把他打倒在地。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Then, jumping into the car, he drove off as quickly as he could.
rows.zh: 随后，战俘跳上汽车，以最快的速度开走了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Fishermen and sailors sometimes claim to have seen monsters in the sea.
rows.zh: 渔民和水手有时声称见过海里的怪物。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Though people have often laughed at stories told by seamen, it is now known that many of these ‘monsters’ which have at times been sighted are simply strange fish.
rows.zh: 虽然人们常常嘲笑海员讲的这些故事，但现在已经知道，这些时而被人目击的“怪物”，许多只不过是奇特的鱼。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Occasionally, unusual creatures are washed to the shore, but they are rarely caught out at sea.
rows.zh: 偶尔会有不寻常的生物被冲到岸上，但人们很少能在外海捕获它们。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Some time ago, however, a peculiar fish was caught near Madagascar.
rows.zh: 不过，前些时候，人们在马达加斯加附近捕到了一条奇鱼。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A small fishing boat was carried miles out to sea by the powerful fish as it pulled on the line.
rows.zh: 这条力大无比的鱼拽着钓线，把一条小渔船拖到了数英里外的海中。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Realizing that this was no ordinary fish, the fisherman made every effort not to damage it in any way.
rows.zh: 渔夫意识到这不是一条普通的鱼，于是竭力避免以任何方式伤害它。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When it was eventually brought to shore, it was found to be over thirteen feet long.
rows.zh: 等鱼终于被运到岸上，人们发现它有十三英尺多长。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It had a head like a horse, big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red tail.
rows.zh: 它的头长得像马，有一双蓝色的大眼睛，银色的皮肤闪闪发亮，还有一条鲜红的尾巴。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The fish, which has since been sent to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish.
rows.zh: 这种鱼叫皇带鱼，后来被送进了一家博物馆，正在那里由一名科学家研究。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Such creatures have rarely been seen alive by man as they live at a depth of six hundred feet.
rows.zh: 这类生物生活在六百英尺深的海中，因此人类极少见到它们活着的样子。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The former Prime Minister, Mr. Wentworth Lane, was defeated in the recent elections.
rows.zh: 前首相温特沃思·莱恩先生在最近的选举中落败了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He is now retiring from political life and has gone abroad.
rows.zh: 他现在正退出政治生活，并且已经去了国外。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: My friend, Patrick, has always been a fanatical opponent of Mr. Lane's Radical Progressive Party.
rows.zh: 我的朋友帕特里克，一向是莱恩先生的激进进步党的狂热反对者。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After the elections, Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.
rows.zh: 选举结束后，帕特里克去了前首相家。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When he asked if Mr. Lane lived there, the policeman on duty told him that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.
rows.zh: 他问莱恩先生是否住在那里，值班警察告诉他，前首相自从败选以后就去了国外。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: On the following day, Patrick went to the house again.
rows.zh: 第二天，帕特里克又去了那所房子。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The same policeman was just walking slowly past the entrance, when Patrick asked the same question.
rows.zh: 同一名警察正从门口慢慢走过，这时帕特里克又问了同样的问题。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Though a little suspicious this time, the policeman gave him the same answer.
rows.zh: 这一次，警察虽然有些起疑，仍给了他同样的回答。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The day after, Patrick went to the house once more and asked exactly the same question.
rows.zh: 又过了一天，帕特里克再次来到那所房子前，问了完全一样的问题。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This time, the policeman lost his temper.
rows.zh: 这回，警察发火了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘I told you yesterday and the day before yesterday,’ he shouted, ‘Mr. Lane was defeated in the elections.
rows.zh: “我昨天和前天都告诉你了，”他大声喊道，“莱恩先生在选举中落败了。
rows.speaker: 警察

rows.en: He has retired from political life and gone to live abroad!’
rows.zh: 他已经退出政坛，到国外居住去了！”
rows.speaker: 警察

rows.en: ‘I know,’ answered Patrick, ‘but I love to hear you say it!’
rows.zh: “我知道，”帕特里克回答，“可我就是喜欢听你这样说！”
rows.speaker: 帕特里克

rows.en: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
rows.zh: 公共汽车职工们决定下周罢工。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.
rows.zh: 罢工定于星期二开始。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: No one knows how long it will last.
rows.zh: 没有人知道罢工会持续多久。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue until general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.
rows.zh: 公共汽车职工们声明，罢工将持续到大家就工资和工作条件达成一致为止。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.
rows.zh: 大多数人认为，这次罢工至少会持续一周。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Many owners of private cars are going to offer ‘free rides’ to people on their way to work.
rows.zh: 许多私家车车主打算为上班途中的人提供“免费搭车”的便利。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent.
rows.zh: 这将在一定程度上减轻火车的压力。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Meanwhile, a number of university students have volunteered to drive buses while the strike lasts.
rows.zh: 与此同时，一些大学生自愿在罢工期间驾驶公共汽车。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: All the students are expert drivers, but before they drive any of the buses, they will have to pass a special test.
rows.zh: 这些学生都很擅长开车，但在驾驶任何一辆公共汽车之前，都必须通过一项专门考试。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The students are going to take the test in two days’ time.
rows.zh: 学生们将在两天后参加考试。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Even so, people are going to find it difficult to get to work.
rows.zh: 即便如此，人们还是会发现上班很困难。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But so far, the public has expressed its gratitude to the students in letters to the Press.
rows.zh: 不过到目前为止，公众已经通过给报社写信，表达了对学生们的感谢。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Only one or two people have objected that the students will drive too fast!
rows.zh: 只有一两个人提出异议，说学生们会把车开得太快！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I have just received a letter from my old school, informing me that my former headmaster, Mr. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
rows.zh: 我刚收到母校的一封信，通知我以前的校长斯图尔特·佩奇先生将于下周退休。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Pupils of the school, old and new, will be sending him a present to mark the occasion.
rows.zh: 学校的新老学生将送给他一份礼物，以纪念这个时刻。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names in a large album which will be sent to the headmaster’s home.
rows.zh: 所有捐钱购买礼物的人，都将在一本大纪念册上签名，这本纪念册将送到校长家中。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience and understanding and for the kindly encouragement he gave us when we went so unwillingly to school.
rows.zh: 我们都会记得佩奇先生的耐心和体谅，也会记得我们很不情愿地上学时，他给予我们的亲切鼓励。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
rows.zh: 下星期四，许多毕业生将出席为他举行的告别晚宴。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.
rows.zh: 说来也巧，到退休前一天，佩奇先生的教学生涯将正好满四十年。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After he has retired, he will devote himself to gardening.
rows.zh: 退休以后，他会专心从事园艺。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: For him, this will be an entirely new hobby.
rows.zh: 对他来说，这将是一项全新的爱好。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But this does not matter, for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn.
rows.zh: 但这没有关系，因为正如他常说的，活到老，学到老。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As the man tried to swing the speedboat round, the steering wheel came away in his hands.
rows.zh: 那个人正想让快艇掉头时，方向盘竟在他手里脱落了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He waved desperately to his companion, who had been water skiing for the last fifteen minutes.
rows.zh: 他拼命向同伴挥手示意，那位同伴此前已经连续滑水十五分钟了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.
rows.zh: 两人还没来得及弄清发生了什么，就被猛地甩进了海里。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The speedboat had struck a buoy, but it continued to move very quickly across the water.
rows.zh: 快艇撞上了一个浮标，却仍在水面上飞速前进。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Both men had just begun to swim towards the shore, when they noticed with dismay that the speedboat was moving in a circle.
rows.zh: 两人刚开始朝岸边游，就惊恐地发现快艇正在绕圈行驶。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It now came straight towards them at tremendous speed.
rows.zh: 这时，它正以惊人的速度朝他们直冲过来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In less than a minute, it roared past them only a few feet away.
rows.zh: 不到一分钟，它就从离他们只有几英尺远的地方轰鸣着掠过。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: After it had passed, they swam on as quickly as they could because they knew that the boat would soon return.
rows.zh: 快艇驶过之后，两人尽快继续往前游，因为他们知道它很快又会回来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.
rows.zh: 他们刚来得及游出危险区域，快艇就又绕完了一圈。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: On this occasion, however, it had slowed down considerably.
rows.zh: 不过这一次，它的速度已经慢了许多。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The petrol had nearly all been used up.
rows.zh: 汽油几乎全用完了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Before long, the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently across the water.
rows.zh: 不久，声音完全消失，快艇开始在水面上缓缓漂流。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘At the time the murder was committed, I was travelling on the 8 o’clock train to London,’ said the man.
rows.zh: “发生谋杀案的时候，我正在乘坐八点开往伦敦的那班火车，”那人说。
rows.speaker: 男子

rows.en: ‘Do you always catch such an early train?’ asked the inspector.
rows.zh: “你总是乘这么早的火车吗？”探长问。
rows.speaker: 探长

rows.en: ‘Of course I do,’ answered the man.
rows.zh: “当然，”那人回答。
rows.speaker: 男子

rows.en: ‘I must be at work at 10 o'clock.
rows.zh: “我必须在十点钟上班。
rows.speaker: 男子

rows.en: My employer will confirm that I was there on time.’
rows.zh: 我的雇主可以证明我那天准时到了。”
rows.speaker: 男子

rows.en: ‘Would a later train get you to work on time?’ asked the inspector.
rows.zh: “如果乘晚一班的火车，你还能准时上班吗？”探长问。
rows.speaker: 探长

rows.en: ‘I suppose it would, but I never catch a later train.’
rows.zh: “我想可以，不过我从来不乘晚一班的火车。”
rows.speaker: 男子

rows.en: ‘At what time did you arrive at the station?’
rows.zh: “你几点到的车站？”
rows.speaker: 探长

rows.en: ‘At ten to eight.
rows.zh: “七点五十分。
rows.speaker: 男子

rows.en: I bought a paper and waited for the train.’
rows.zh: 我买了份报纸，等着火车来。”
rows.speaker: 男子

rows.en: ‘And you didn’t notice anything unusual?’
rows.zh: “那么，你没有注意到什么异常吗？”
rows.speaker: 探长

rows.en: ‘Of course not.’
rows.zh: “当然没有。”
rows.speaker: 男子

rows.en: ‘I suggest,’ said the inspector, ‘that you are not telling the truth.
rows.zh: “我认为，”探长说，“你没有说实话。
rows.speaker: 探长

rows.en: I suggest that you did not catch the 8 o'clock train, but that you caught the 8.25 which would still get you to work on time.
rows.zh: 我认为，你乘的不是八点那班火车，而是八点二十五分那班，那班车照样能让你准时上班。
rows.speaker: 探长

rows.en: You see, on the morning of the murder, the 8 o'clock train did not run at all.
rows.zh: 你知道，谋杀案发生的那天早晨，八点那班火车根本没有开。
rows.speaker: 探长

rows.en: It broke down at Ferngreen station and was taken off the line.’
rows.zh: 它在芬格林站出了故障，被撤下停运了。”
rows.speaker: 探长

rows.en: Six men have been trapped in a mine for seventeen hours.
rows.zh: 六个人已经被困在矿井里十七个小时了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If they are not brought to the surface soon they may lose their lives.
rows.zh: 如果不能很快把他们救到地面，他们可能会丧命。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: However, rescue operations are proving difficult.
rows.zh: 然而，救援工作困难重重。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If explosives are used, vibrations will cause the roof of the mine to collapse.
rows.zh: 如果使用炸药，震动就会使矿井顶部坍塌。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Rescue workers are therefore drilling a hole on the north side of the mine.
rows.zh: 因此，救援人员正在矿井北侧钻一个洞。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They intend to bring the men up in a special capsule.
rows.zh: 他们打算用一只特制救生舱把这些人提上来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If there had not been a hard layer of rock beneath the soil, they would have completed the job in a few hours.
rows.zh: 如果泥土下面没有一层坚硬的岩石，他们本来几个小时就能完工。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As it is, they have been drilling for sixteen hours and they still have a long way to go.
rows.zh: 实际情况却是，他们已经钻了十六个小时，仍有很长一段距离需要打通。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Meanwhile, a microphone, which was lowered into the mine two hours ago, has enabled the men to keep in touch with their closest relatives.
rows.zh: 与此同时，两小时前放入矿井的一个麦克风，让被困者能够与最亲近的家人保持联系。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Though they are running out of food and drink, the men are cheerful and confident that they will get out soon.
rows.zh: 虽然食物和饮水快要用完，这些人仍然情绪乐观，坚信自己很快就能脱困。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They have been told that rescue operations are progressing smoothly.
rows.zh: 有人告诉他们，救援工作进展顺利。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If they knew how difficult it was to drill through the hard rock, they would lose heart.
rows.zh: 如果他们知道钻透坚硬的岩石有多困难，就会失去信心。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: People will do anything to see a free show — even if it is a bad one.
rows.zh: 为了看一场免费演出，人们什么都愿意做，哪怕演出很差也无所谓。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When the news got round that a comedy show would be presented at our local cinema by the P. and U. Bird Seed Company, we all rushed to see it.
rows.zh: 消息传来，说P和U鸟食公司要在我们当地的电影院举办一场喜剧演出，我们便都赶去观看。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: We had to queue for hours to get in and there must have been several hundred people present just before the show began.
rows.zh: 我们排了好几个小时的队才能进去，而就在演出开始前，现场想必已经有好几百人了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Unfortunately, the show was one of the dullest we have ever seen.
rows.zh: 不幸的是，这是我们看过的最乏味的演出之一。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed, as many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come.
rows.zh: 没能进去的人本来不必感到失望，因为许多本该出场的艺人都没有来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The only funny things we heard that evening came from the advertiser at the beginning of the programme.
rows.zh: 那天晚上，我们听到的唯一好笑的内容，来自节目开始时的广告报幕员。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He was obviously very nervous and for some minutes stood awkwardly before the microphone.
rows.zh: 他显然十分紧张，在麦克风前局促地站了好几分钟。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
rows.zh: 他刚一开口，所有人就哄堂大笑。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: We all know what the poor man should have said, but what he actually said was: ‘This is the Poo and Ee Seed Bird Company.
rows.zh: 我们都知道这个可怜的人本来应该说什么，可他实际上说的却是：“这里是普和伊籽鸟公司。
rows.speaker: 旁白与广告报幕员

rows.en: Good ladies, evening and gentlemen!’
rows.zh: 好女士们，晚上和先生们！”
rows.speaker: 广告报幕员

rows.en: Fish and chips has always been a favourite dish in Britain, but as the oceans have been overfished, fish has become more and more expensive.
rows.zh: 炸鱼配薯条一直是英国人喜爱的一道菜，但由于海洋遭到过度捕捞，鱼变得越来越贵。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: So it comes as a surprise to learn that giant fish are terrifying the divers on North Sea oil rigs.
rows.zh: 因此，听说巨鱼正让北海石油钻井平台的潜水员惊恐不已，实在令人吃惊。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Oil rigs have to be repaired frequently and divers, who often have to work in darkness a hundred feet under water, have been frightened out of their wits by giant fish bumping into them as they work.
rows.zh: 钻井平台需要经常维修，潜水员往往得在水下一百英尺深的黑暗中工作，而他们工作时撞来的巨鱼，把他们吓得魂不附体。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Now they have had special cages made to protect them from these monsters.
rows.zh: 现在，他们已经请人特制了一些笼子，以保护自己免受这些巨物的侵扰。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The fish are not sharks or killer whales, but favourite eating varieties like cod and skate which grow to unnatural sizes, sometimes as much as twelve feet in length.
rows.zh: 这些鱼并不是鲨鱼或虎鲸，而是人们喜爱食用的鳕鱼、鳐鱼等品种，它们长到了异乎寻常的大小，有时长达十二英尺。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Three factors have caused these fish to grow so large: the warm water round the hot oil pipes under the sea; the plentiful supply of food thrown overboard by the crews on the rigs; the total absence of fishing boats around the oil rigs.
rows.zh: 三个因素使这些鱼长得如此巨大：海底热输油管道周围温暖的海水；钻井平台工作人员扔下海的大量食物；以及平台周围完全没有渔船。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As a result, the fish just eat and eat and grow and grow in the lovely warm water.
rows.zh: 结果，这些鱼就在舒适温暖的水里，吃了又吃，长了又长。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Who cats who?
rows.zh: 究竟是谁吃谁呢？
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force Station nearby.
rows.zh: 一名飞行员发现了一个气球，它似乎正朝附近的皇家空军基地飞去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He informed the station at once, but no one there was able to explain the mystery.
rows.zh: 他立即通知了基地，但那里没有人能解释这是怎么回事。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news, because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
rows.zh: 控制塔上的军官听到消息后十分生气，因为气球可能给飞机带来很大危险。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He said that someone might be spying on the station and the pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
rows.zh: 他说，可能有人正在侦察基地，于是飞行员接到命令，跟踪这个奇怪的物体。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
rows.zh: 飞行员设法围绕气球盘旋了一阵子。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He could make out three men in a basket under it and one of them was holding a pair of binoculars.
rows.zh: 他能看清气球下面的吊篮里有三个人，其中一人拿着一副双筒望远镜。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When the balloon was over the station, the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
rows.zh: 气球飞到基地上空时，飞行员看见其中一人在拍照。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.
rows.zh: 没过多久，气球开始下降，落在一处机场附近。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The police were called in, but they could not arrest anyone, for the basket contained two Members of Parliament and the Commanding Officer of the station!
rows.zh: 警察被叫来了，却无法逮捕任何人，因为吊篮里坐着的是两名议员和这座基地的指挥官！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As the Commanding Officer explained later, one half of the station did not know what the other half was doing!
rows.zh: 正如指挥官后来解释的，基地里一半的人不知道另一半的人在做什么！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It must have been about two in the morning when I returned home.
rows.zh: 我回到家时，想必已经是凌晨两点左右了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I tried to wake up my wife by ringing the doorbell, but she was fast asleep, so I got a ladder from the shed in the garden, put it against the wall, and began climbing towards the bedroom window.
rows.zh: 我按门铃，想叫醒妻子，可她睡得很熟，于是我从花园的棚子里拿来一架梯子，靠在墙上，开始往卧室窗户爬。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I was almost there when a sarcastic voice below said, ‘I don’t think the windows need cleaning at this time of the night.’
rows.zh: 我差不多爬到那里时，下面传来一个讥讽的声音：“我想，不用在半夜这个时候擦窗户吧。”
rows.speaker: 旁白与警察

rows.en: I looked down and nearly fell off the ladder when I saw a policeman.
rows.zh: 我往下一看，发现是个警察，差点从梯子上掉下来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I immediately regretted answering in the way I did, but I said, ‘I enjoy cleaning windows at night.’
rows.zh: 我马上就为自己的回答后悔了，可我当时说的是：“我就喜欢晚上擦窗户。”
rows.speaker: 旁白与我

rows.en: ‘So do I,’ answered the policeman in the same tone.
rows.zh: “我也一样，”警察用同样的口气回答。
rows.speaker: 警察

rows.en: ‘Excuse my interrupting you.
rows.zh: “请原谅我打断你。
rows.speaker: 警察

rows.en: I hate to interrupt a man when he’s busy working, but would you mind coming with me to the station?’
rows.zh: 我不愿意打扰忙着干活的人，不过，你介意跟我到警察局走一趟吗？”
rows.speaker: 警察

rows.en: ‘Well, I'd prefer to stay here,’ I said.
rows.zh: “嗯，我还是愿意留在这里，”我说。
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘You see, I've forgotten my key.’
rows.zh: “你看，我忘带钥匙了。”
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: ‘Your what?’ he called.
rows.zh: “你的什么？”他大声问。
rows.speaker: 警察

rows.en: ‘My key,’ I shouted.
rows.zh: “我的钥匙！”我喊道。
rows.speaker: 我

rows.en: Fortunately, the shouting woke up my wife who opened the window just as the policeman had started to climb towards me.
rows.zh: 幸好，喊声吵醒了妻子，警察刚开始朝我爬上来，她就打开了窗户。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: One of the most famous monuments in the world, the Statue of Liberty, was presented to the United States of America in the nineteenth century by the people of France.
rows.zh: 自由女神像是世界上最著名的纪念性建筑之一，是法国人民在十九世纪赠送给美国的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
rows.zh: 这座宏伟的雕像由雕塑家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计，历时十年才完成。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The actual figure was made of copper supported by a metal framework which had been especially constructed by Eiffel.
rows.zh: 雕像本体用铜制成，由一副金属框架支撑，这副框架是埃菲尔专门建造的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Before it could be transported to the United States, a site had to be found for it and a pedestal had to be built.
rows.zh: 在把雕像运往美国以前，必须先为它选好地点，建起基座。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The site chosen was an island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
rows.zh: 最终选定的地点是纽约港入口处的一个小岛。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: By 1884, a statue which was 151 feet tall had been erected in Paris.
rows.zh: 到1884年，一座高一百五十一英尺的雕像已经在巴黎竖起。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The following year, it was taken to pieces and sent to America.
rows.zh: 第二年，人们把它拆开，运往美国。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: By the end of October 1886, the statue had been put together again and it was officially presented to the American people by Bartholdi.
rows.zh: 到1886年10月底，雕像已经重新组装完毕，由巴托尔迪正式赠送给美国人民。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Ever since then, the great monument has been a symbol of liberty for the millions of people who have passed through New York Harbour to make their homes in America.
rows.zh: 从那以后，对于经过纽约港、前往美国安家落户的数百万人来说，这座伟大的纪念像一直是自由的象征。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
rows.zh: 实验证明，孩子很小的时候就能接受游泳训练。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles, children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.
rows.zh: 在洛杉矶一座专门的游泳池里，孩子们还不会走路，就已经很擅长在水下屏气。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
rows.zh: 两个月大的婴儿似乎并不抗拒下水。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
rows.zh: 没过多久，他们就十分习惯游泳，能够从池底拾起重物。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
rows.zh: 这些小小游泳者非常喜欢的一种游戏，是水下三轮车比赛。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
rows.zh: 三轮车在水面下七英尺深的池底排成一行。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.
rows.zh: 孩子们互相比赛，看谁先到达游泳池的另一端。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Many pedal their tricycles, but most of them prefer to push or drag them.
rows.zh: 不少孩子踩着三轮车的踏板前进，但大多数更愿意推着或拖着车走。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.
rows.zh: 有些孩子能够游完整个泳池，连一次都不用浮上水面换气。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
rows.zh: 他们将来是否会成为奥运会冠军，只有时间才能回答。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Meanwhile, they should encourage those among us who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air.
rows.zh: 与此同时，他们应该能鼓励我们当中那些还游不到五码就已经上气不接下气的人。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When the Ambassador of Escalopia returned home for lunch, his wife got a shock.
rows.zh: 艾斯卡洛比亚的大使回家吃午饭时，他的妻子吓了一跳。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He looked pale and his clothes were in a frightful state.
rows.zh: 他脸色苍白，衣服也糟糕得不像样。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘What has happened?’ she asked.
rows.zh: “出了什么事？”她问。
rows.speaker: 大使夫人

rows.en: ‘How did your clothes get into such a mess?’
rows.zh: “你的衣服怎么弄得这么乱？”
rows.speaker: 大使夫人

rows.en: ‘A fire extinguisher, my dear,’ answered the Ambassador drily.
rows.zh: “是灭火器弄的，亲爱的，”大使淡淡地回答。
rows.speaker: 大使

rows.en: ‘University students set the Embassy on fire this morning.’
rows.zh: “今天早晨，大学生们把大使馆点着了。”
rows.speaker: 大使

rows.en: ‘Good heavens!’ exclaimed his wife.
rows.zh: “天哪！”妻子惊叫道。
rows.speaker: 大使夫人

rows.en: ‘And where were you at the time?’
rows.zh: “那时你在哪儿？”
rows.speaker: 大使夫人

rows.en: ‘I was in my office as usual,’ answered the Ambassador.
rows.zh: “我像往常一样待在办公室里，”大使回答。
rows.speaker: 大使

rows.en: ‘The fire broke out in the basement.
rows.zh: “地下室起了火。
rows.speaker: 大使

rows.en: I went down immediately, of course, and that fool, Horst, aimed a fire extinguisher at me.
rows.zh: 我当然立刻下楼去了，可霍斯特那个笨蛋把灭火器对准了我。
rows.speaker: 大使

rows.en: He thought I was on fire.
rows.zh: 他以为我身上着火了。
rows.speaker: 大使

rows.en: I must definitely get that fellow posted.’
rows.zh: 我一定得把那家伙调走。”
rows.speaker: 大使

rows.en: The Ambassador's wife went on asking questions, when she suddenly noticed a big hole in her husband's hat.
rows.zh: 大使夫人还在接着提问，忽然发现丈夫的帽子上有个大洞。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: ‘And how can you explain that?’ she asked.
rows.zh: “那这个你怎么解释？”她问。
rows.speaker: 大使夫人

rows.en: ‘Oh, that,’ said the Ambassador.
rows.zh: “哦，那个呀，”大使说。
rows.speaker: 大使

rows.en: ‘Someone fired a shot through my office window.
rows.zh: “有人开了一枪，子弹穿过了我办公室的窗户。
rows.speaker: 大使

rows.en: Accurate, don’t you think?
rows.zh: 打得挺准，你说是不是？
rows.speaker: 大使

rows.en: Fortunately, I wasn’t wearing it at the time.
rows.zh: 幸好，那时我没有戴那顶帽子。
rows.speaker: 大使

rows.en: If I had been, I would not have been able to get home for lunch.’
rows.zh: 要是戴着，我就没法回家吃午饭了。”
rows.speaker: 大使

rows.en: A Festival for the Dead is held once a year in Japan.
rows.zh: 日本每年举行一次祭亡节。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This festival is a cheerful occasion, for on this day, the dead are said to return to their homes and they are welcomed by the living.
rows.zh: 这个节日气氛欢快，因为据说在这一天，亡者会回到家中，受到生者的欢迎。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As they are expected to be hungry after their long journey, food is laid out for them.
rows.zh: 人们认为，亡者经过长途跋涉后会感到饥饿，因此为他们摆好食物。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Specially-made lanterns are hung outside each house to help the dead to find their way.
rows.zh: 每家屋外都挂起特制的灯笼，帮助亡者认路。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: All night long, people dance and sing.
rows.zh: 人们通宵载歌载舞。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In the early morning, the food that had been laid out for the dead is thrown into a river or into the sea as it is considered unlucky for anyone living to eat it.
rows.zh: 到了清晨，先前为亡者摆好的食物会被扔进河里或海里，因为活人吃这些食物被认为不吉利。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In towns that are near the sea, the tiny lanterns which had been hung in the streets the night before, are placed into the water when the festival is over.
rows.zh: 在靠海的城镇，节日结束时，人们会把前一夜挂在街上的小灯笼放进水中。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Thousands of lanterns slowly drift out to sea guiding the dead on their return journey to the other world.
rows.zh: 成千上万盏灯笼缓缓漂向大海，指引亡者踏上返回另一个世界的路程。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This is a moving spectacle, for crowds of people stand on the shore watching the lanterns drifting away until they can be seen no more.
rows.zh: 这是一个感人的景象，因为岸边站着成群的人，目送灯笼渐渐漂远，直到再也看不见。
rows.speaker: 旁白
